name: Zenth
tagline: Autonomous drone inspection for critical infrastructure at scale.
positioning: Zenth turns raw drone flights into audit-ready inspection reports for utilities, telecom, and energy operators — no manual review required.

hero.h1: Every asset inspected. Every defect documented.
hero.sub: Zenth plans the flight, flies the mission, and delivers a compliance-grade inspection report — so your engineers stop reviewing footage frame by frame and start acting on findings.

features.title: Autonomous mission planning
features.description: Define an asset once. Zenth generates repeatable flight paths for towers, turbines, and transmission lines that hold up across quarterly re-inspections.

features.title: AI defect detection
features.description: Corrosion, cracking, and thermal anomalies are flagged, classified, and severity-ranked automatically — before a human ever opens the imagery.

features.title: Audit-ready reporting
features.description: Export inspection packages that map to NERC, OSHA, and internal asset-integrity standards, complete with geotags and chain-of-custody logs.

features.title: Digital twin reconstruction
features.description: Turn every flight into a georeferenced 3D model, so remote teams can measure clearances and track degradation without a site visit.

features.title: Fleet orchestration
features.description: Manage pilots, aircraft, and airspace approvals across regions from one console, with utilization and downtime tracked per unit.

features.title: System of record integration
features.description: Push findings straight into Maximo, SAP, or your EAM via API — no CSV exports, no duplicate data entry between teams.

testimonials.quote: We cut our transmission-line inspection cycle from eleven weeks to nine days. The defect ranking alone lets my engineers triage before they ever leave the office.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: Compliance used to be the bottleneck. Zenth's report packages passed our regulator's audit on the first submission — that has never happened before.
testimonials.name: Rafael Ortega

testimonials.quote: Across 4,200 cell sites, consistency was impossible with contractors. Zenth flies the same mission every quarter, and the data lines up perfectly.
testimonials.name: Priya Nair
